readme-screenshots.source: a local production build reading production's catalog and photos (scripts/readme-screenshots.ts)

ciFixChecks: `npm run format:check` (`npm run format` rewrites what it flags)
`npm run codegen && git diff --exit-code src/gql/` (if a schema change made `src/gql/` drift, commit the regenerated output too)
the "Bundle size budget" step of `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (copy its `run:` commands; after the build)

exempt.PR description: Checks the description's text against the shared shape; a failure is the description to fix, not code autofix can fix.
exempt.PR visuals: Passes every PR while visuals.sharedTemplate is on (visual review decides); a failure would be the workflow, not code autofix can fix.
exempt.Visual review: Runs on pull_request_target and workflow_run from main's code, comparing screenshots; a changed screen is for the owner to accept, not code autofix can fix.
exempt.PR GIFs: Records the PR's GIF scenarios; a failed recording is a scenario or the app to look at, not code autofix can fix.
exempt.PR changes: PR changes: reads the PR as data, runs none of its code.

files: src/gql/**: generated by graphql-codegen from the schema
shared/isoRegions.ts: generated from ISO 3166 by npm run regions:gen
src/lib/iconPaths.ts: generated from Material Symbols by npm run icons:gen
codegen.ts: graphql-codegen config, not app code
src/main.tsx: the DOM entry, run only in the browser, by the visual tests
api/_schema.ts: an SDL string with no code to run
src/test/**: test helpers and setup for the unit tests
tests/visual/**: Playwright support for the visual tests
scripts/gif-scenarios/**: recorded flows played in a browser by npm run gif
